items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: I took him down since Walton got me in a move.

ctx.x: But you were here, you mean, or you were in New Orleans? Yeah, I was in New Orleans. Yeah, yeah.
And, uh, I took him down since Walton got me in a move. What year was that about? You remember Tom? I went to Tuk Johnson in first quarter of 24. Uh-huh.
Is that the Tuk Johnson band up there?
